A11 census rules, logged before the script is written or run (G43's test): (1) each ruled line takes the class it was ruled under, checked against its written decision and kind: instantiate T and TO are the transition (T also the mechanism in words), TF template first, E1 one end, P-G6 other; restrict S-T and S-TO the transition (S-T in words), S-TF template first, S-X across threads, S-TALK talk only, S-LAY layout only, ONE one post, EL evidence limit, P-G6 other; add lines are the transition or template first where the reason says the census counts them so, else held; absent rejects are the transition (in words where the reason says so), particulars other, the rest limits. (2) A room is counted in each class its lines show, then once by priority: transition, template first, across threads, one post, talk only, layout only, one end, held, el, other, limit; a room may show the transition in one thread and template first in another, since A11 claims no order between rooms. (3) Shares: rooms showing the transition among rooms whose lines show both ends (transition, template first, across threads), and with one-post rooms added; rooms whose lines show the mechanism in words as a share of the transition rooms; talk only and layout only, the failure clause's cases, reported apart; all beside C2's 82 transitions in 36 rooms and its room-level order, 111 of 185 (0.600; null mean 0.618)
